headline.zh: 为AI编码团队部署运维代理
headline.en: Deploy Operations Agents for AI Coding Teams

scenario.zh: 某电商平台开发团队使用AI编码工具后代码量增长快，需要自动化处理增多的线上事件和监控告警
scenario.en: E-commerce dev team using AI coding sees code volume surge, needs to automate growing production incidents and monitoring alerts

instruction.zh: 先为哪类工作流部署AI代理？
instruction.en: Which workflow should deploy AI agents first?

output.zh: 看板显示待处理告警：3个高延迟、2个内存溢出，代理自动关联日志
output.en: Board shows pending alerts: 3 high latency, 2 memory overflow, agent auto-links logs

output.zh: 看板显示待审查PR：5个安全风险标记、8个性能问题待确认
output.en: Board shows PRs for review: 5 security risk flags, 8 performance issues pending

output.zh: 代理已分析3个告警的调用链，在看板标注疑似数据库连接池耗尽
output.en: Agent analyzed 3 alerts' traces, marked suspected DB connection pool exhaustion on board

output.zh: 代理提交诊断报告到看板：建议扩容连接池并添加超时熔断
output.en: Agent submitted diagnostic report to board: suggests expanding pool and adding timeout circuit breaker

instruction.zh: 对比人工处理与代理处理的差异
instruction.en: Compare manual handling vs agent handling

output.zh: 15分钟内完成根因定位，自动生成修复任务并关联相关文档
output.en: Root cause located in 15 min, auto-generated fix task linked to relevant docs

output.zh: 需要跨3个团队沟通，平均2小时定位问题，手动整理修复方案
output.en: Requires cross-team coordination across 3 groups, 2 hours average to locate issue, manual fix plan

instruction.zh: 根据执行数据优化代理能力
instruction.en: Optimize agent capability based on execution data

output.zh: 看板新增性能优化、成本分析两类任务，代理覆盖面增强
output.en: Board adds performance optimization and cost analysis tasks, agent coverage enhanced

output.zh: 事件响应代理新增自动回滚能力，可直接执行紧急修复操作
output.en: Incident response agent adds auto-rollback capability, can execute emergency fixes directly

takeaway.zh: 通过AI代理控制平面，将AI编码带来的运维负担转化为自动化能力提升
takeaway.en: Transform operational burden from AI coding into automation capability boost via AI agent control plane

initial.zh: 处理支付服务高延迟告警，分析日志并定位根因
initial.en: Handle payment service high latency alert, analyze logs and identify root cause
